result.title: FedBST: Bilateral Self-Training for Unsupervised Federated Classification
result.summary: Unsupervised federated learning with Vision-Language Models (e.g., CLIP) offers a promising solution for label-free classification, yet its performance often degrades under severe non-IID shifts. A pioneering method, FedCoPL, typically relies on self-training strategies that exclusively prioritize high-confidence predictions for pseudo-labeling. However, this selective approach neglects the information of ambiguous samples (often referred to as ``waist" samples), leading to the underutilization of data and biased decision boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose FedBST, a bilateral self-training framework that effectively exploits both high-confidence and ambiguous data. Specifically, for local optimization, we introduce uncertainty-aware confidence penalization (UACP). UACP targets ambiguous samples by penalizing overconfident predictions to implicitly promote higher uncertainty, thereby preventing erroneous pseudo-labeling. At inference, we employ a visual-text ensemble strategy. This approach aggregates uncertainty-aware local visual prototypes and ensembles them with textual prototypes, achieving lightweight adaptation to local distributions via prototype-based calibration. Experiments demonstrate that FedBST achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with standard federated aggregation protocols.

AI.brief_summary: 面向基于 CLIP 的无监督联邦分类，提出 FedBST 双边自训练框架：用不确定性感知的置信度惩罚处理含糊样本以避免错误伪标签，并在推理时融合视觉原型与文本原型做轻量校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其用不确定性区分「含糊样本」并借助原型校准决策的做法，可能为判断视觉证据是否充分、何时继续 LOOK 或 STOP 提供线索，可供核查。
